column1: # Spread of the systematic/fluctuation decomposition across INDEPENDENT
# source-realization ensembles (R=100 each).  The originally published
# numbers came from ONE ensemble (seed 20260728) with no uncertainty.
# Replication showed that draw is the extreme of the set for the flat
# fluctuation rise.  Every seed either reviewer generated is included.
# The 256^2 bias sits AT the measured sampling floor of its own
# estimator, so bias ratios are one-sided bounds, not estimates, and
# ratio-of-means is used (mean-of-ratios is biased high in that regime).
